name: John McKinney
office: City of Los Angeles, City Attorney

items.text: John McKinney is a Los Angeles County deputy district attorney. He has spent much of his nearly 30-year legal career in the Major Crimes Division prosecuting violent cases. He prosecuted the killers of rapper Nipsey Hussle and, according to his campaign, has handled about 40 murder cases.

sentences.text: John McKinney is a Los Angeles County deputy district attorney.
He has spent much of his nearly 30-year legal career in the Major Crimes Division prosecuting violent cases.
He prosecuted the killers of rapper Nipsey Hussle and, according to his campaign, has handled about 40 murder cases.

items.text: McKinney prioritizes public safety, including action on organized retail theft, drug dealing, and street racing. He supports more aggressive misdemeanor gun prosecutions and using arrests to move homeless people into mental health or addiction treatment. His campaign proposes restoring a Neighborhood Prosecutor Program, starting with two prosecutors assigned to downtown. He also says he would reduce legal payouts by improving training for city workers and police.
